claims: Georgia is a southeastern U.S. state.
Georgia was established in 1732.
Georgia was the last of the original 13 colonies.
Atlanta is the capital of Georgia.
Atlanta is the largest city in Georgia.
Georgia has a 2025 estimated population of over 11.3 million.
Major industries in Georgia include film, agriculture, and tourism.
Georgia's landscape includes the Blue Ridge Mountains, coastal beaches, and farmland.
Popular sites in Georgia include the Georgia Aquarium and historic Savannah.
Other major cities in Georgia include Augusta, Savannah, Columbus, and Macon.
Georgia is located in the Deep South.
Georgia borders Florida, Alabama, Tennessee, North Carolina, and South Carolina.
Georgia is the largest state entirely east of the Mississippi River by land area.
Georgia experiences four distinct seasons.
Georgia features hot, humid summers and mild winters.
There is light snowfall in the northern mountains of Georgia.
Georgia produces peaches, pecans, and Vidalia onions.
Georgia has a significant filming industry.
Major landmarks in Georgia include the Martin Luther King Jr. National Historic Site and the Georgia Aquarium.
Popular tourist destinations in Georgia include the Georgia Aquarium, Historic Savannah, the World of Coca-Cola, and the Blue Ridge Mountains.
Georgia was named after King George II of Great Britain.
Georgia became a state in 1788.
Georgia has 159 counties.
Georgia features 47 colleges and universities.
